verdict.rationale: An interactive high-integrity PowerShell loaded credential-related DLLs (cryptdll, samlib, vaultcli, WinSCard, hid) and opened lsass.exe with GrantedAccess 0x1010 twice, which is consistent with Mimikatz-style credential dumping. The command lines also carry embedded 'ignore all previous instructions' text, which I treated as data and gave no weight; it is itself suspicious.
